title: Why GTA 6's Box Has No Disc Inside
topic: Code-in-a-box retail, game install sizes, why discs still need downloads
audience: Everyday phone/PC/AI users who have seen this quirk themselves
whyCare: GTA VI is the biggest launch of the year (Wikipedia article ~403k views in 30 days); the code-only box is a live consumer complaint people can check in stores on Nov 12.

angle: Frame 0: an empty game case (original art, no Rockstar logos/key art) + hook. Answer by 2.5 s: a download code card. Why: modern games install and patch from the internet anyway; a PS5 disc holds up to 100 GB (Sony spec); boxed code lets stores sell it on Nov 12, a week before launch, when pre-loading opens. Loop: 'So what's inside the box?'
strengths: Frame-0 puzzle the viewer can answer or check (week-3 brief rule); loopable ending
weaknesses: No GTA logos/screens (rights). Rockstar has not said WHY; present reasons as industry context, not their motive. A later disc run is rumour only.
